name: Capital call notice
what: A notice to investors to fund part of their commitment by a date, with the amount, purpose and how to pay.

fields.label: Investor
fields.definition: The investor the notice is addressed to.

fields.label: Amount called
fields.definition: The amount this notice asks the investor to fund.

fields.label: Share of commitment called
fields.definition: The amount called as a share of the investor's commitment.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.definition: What the money is for, such as a closing, reserves or fees.

fields.label: Due date
fields.definition: The date by which the money must arrive.

fields.label: How to confirm payment details
fields.definition: The channel the investor uses to confirm wire instructions before sending money.

fields.label: Unfunded commitment after this call
fields.definition: The commitment that remains uncalled once this call is funded.

fields.label: Default terms
fields.definition: Where the governing agreement sets out what happens if an investor does not fund.
